'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Darfur campaign (2023–present)|Darfur campaign]]
***[[Battle of Geneina]]
****[[Rapid Support Forces]] re-capture [[Geneina]], the capital of [[West Darfur]], after a week of fighting with more than 200 people killed. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/sudan-darfur-bloodshed-hemeti-allies-enemies-control  (Middle East Eye)] [https://www.dabangasudan.org/en/all-news/article/nearly-200-confirmed-dead-in-west-darfur-violence-situation-extremely-dangerous (Dabanga Sudan)] 
**[[Sudanese refugee crisis]]
***The number of Sudanese refugees due to the ongoing [[civil war|civil conflict]] surpasses 100,000 after only a few days. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/over-100000-refugees-crossed-sudan-neighbouring-countries-un-2023-05-02/ (Reuters)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**Somali forces kill 67 [[al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] militants and seize many weapons in a continuation of offensives against the group in the [[Mudug]] region. [https://www.voanews.com/a/somali-army-kills-67-al-shabab-militants-seizes-explosives-/7075508.html (VOA)]
*A [[Uganda People's Defence Force]] soldier [[assassination|assassinates]] retired [[colonel]] and [[Cabinet of Uganda|cabinet member]] [[Charles Engola]] at his home in [[Kampala]], while acting as his bodyguard. The soldier later commits suicide. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-65454213 (BBC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2023 Writers Guild of America strike]]
**The [[Writers Guild of America]] goes on [[strike action|strike]] for the first time since [[2007–08 Writers Guild of America strike|2007–08]]. [https://www.latimes.com/entertainment-arts/business/story/2023-05-01/hollywood-writers-strike-after-talks-over-pay-conditions-in-streaming-age-fail (''Los Angeles Times'')]
*[[India]]n airline [[Go First]] files for bankruptcy with the [[National Company Law Tribunal]], blaming "faulty" [[Pratt & Whitney]]-manufactured engines for the grounding of about half of its fleet, costing the airline 108 billion [[Indian rupee|rupees]] ($1.32 billion) in lost revenues. [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/indias-cash-strapped-go-first-airways-suspends-flights-et-2023-05-02/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[List of earthquakes in 2023]]
**Ten people are injured and more than 2,805 buildings are damaged after a magnitude 5.3 earthquake strikes [[Baoshan, Yunnan|Baoshan]], [[Yunnan]], [[China]]. [https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202305/03/WS645215a0a310b6054fad0d47.html (ChinaDaily)] 
*Five people are missing in [[Darchula District]], [[Nepal]], after being struck by an [[avalanche]]. [https://english.news.cn/20230502/477378868e39447e858fa619d7bfec07/c.html (Xinhua)]
'''Law and crime'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**Former [[Palestinian Islamic Jihad]] spokesman [[Khader Adnan]] dies in an [[Israel]]i prison after a three-month [[hunger strike]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/5/2/israel-palestine-live-hunger-striking-prisoner-khader-adnan-dies (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Indonesian Ulema Council shooting]]
**A man armed with an [[airgun]] opens fire at the [[Indonesian Ulema Council]] [[headquarters]] in [[Menteng]], [[Central Jakarta]], [[Java]], injuring two employees. The attacker later dies at a local health center. [https://news.detik.com/berita/d-6700035/kronologi-penembakan-kantor-mui-pusat-hingga-pelaku-tewas (Detik)]
*[[LGBT rights in Uganda]], [[Anti-Homosexuality Bill, 2023]]
**The [[parliament of Uganda]] passes new [[Violence against LGBT people|anti-LGBTQ+]] laws after [[President of Uganda|president]] [[Yoweri Museveni]] requested reforms. The bill maintains the [[Capital punishment in Uganda|death penalty]] as a punishment for "aggravated homosexuality". [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/uganda-parliament-passes-mostly-unchanged-version-anti-lgbtq-bill-2023-05-02/ (Reuters)]
*The [[United States Department of Defense]] announces that it will deploy 1,500 troops along the [[Mexico-United States border|Mexican border]] to provide non-law enforcement related administrative assistance to the [[United States Border Patrol]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/05/02/politics/us-troops-border-migrant-surge/index.html (CNN)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[May 2023 Greek legislative election|2023 Greek legislative election]]
**The [[Greece|Greek]] [[Supreme Civil and Criminal Court of Greece|Supreme Civil and Criminal Court]] bans the [[far-right politics|far-right]] [[National Party – Greeks|National Party]], led by [[Ilias Kasidiaris]], from participating in the upcoming [[elections in greece|general election]], after the court accused the party of being a "continuation of the [[Golden Dawn (Greece)|Golden Dawn]]". [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230502-greece-bans-party-linked-to-neo-nazi-group-from-may-vote (France 24)]
